trailhead.label: the Ronacherfels on the north shore, the board’s start

waypoints.label: Drinking water on the east shore

cautions: A narrow lakeside path with roots and short steps that runs right above the water in places: keep your dog close.
The boardwalk at the east end is shared with cyclists.
Swimmers and boats near the shore in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
